meanings.note: only when answering or making a phone call
магнитные бури = magnetic storms (often blamed for feeling unwell)

examples.trans: The magnetic storms are strong today.
Everything's fine, it's just the magnetic storms.

examples.text: Пускай все бури и штормы обойдут вас.
examples.trans: May all storms and gales pass you by.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: year (affectionate, used for small children's age)

examples.text: Тут мальчик, два годика, зовут Рома.
examples.trans: There's a little boy here, two years old, called Roma.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.
We'll make it! The president always talks for a long time.
The main thing is, you keep him at home.

examples.text: А Осипенко сейчас дома лежит. У него больное сердце.
examples.trans: And Osipenko is lying at home right now. He has a sick heart.

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: Звать на помощь = to call for help.
как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
There are strong magnetic storms today.
Everything is fine, just magnetic storms.

examples.text: И майка у него с пауком.
examples.trans: And his T-shirt has a spider on it.

examples.text: Летом я хожу в белой майке.
examples.trans: In summer I wear a white tank top.

meanings.note: used to address a child you don't know

examples.text: Жизнь срывает с нас эти маски.
examples.trans: Life tears these masks off us.
He left for a short time.

examples.text: Спасибо, я словно ненадолго вернулся домой!
examples.trans: Thank you, I felt as if I briefly returned home!

examples.text: В душном автобусе ей стало плохо, и она упала в обморок.
examples.trans: On the stuffy bus she felt ill and fainted.
Afterwards I'll drive you back for free.

examples.text: Вот это дело! Потом обратно бесплатно отвезу.
examples.trans: Now we're talking! Afterwards I'll drive you back for free.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: быть в отключке = to be out cold

examples.text: После удара он был в отключке пару минут.
examples.trans: After the blow he was out cold for a couple of minutes.

отъехать.gloss: to pop out, to drive off

examples.trans: Angelina, I need to pop out for a bit.

examples.text: Мальчики, я сейчас отъеду на пару часов.
examples.trans: Boys, I'm heading out for a couple of hours.

meanings.note: declines like a feminine noun in -а, but is masculine

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: И майка у него с пауком.
examples.trans: And his T-shirt has a spider on it.

examples.text: Наверное, я случайно проглотил ночью паука.
examples.trans: I must have accidentally swallowed a spider in the night.

examples.text: А здесь чёрные пауки из бельгийского шоколада.
examples.trans: And here are black spiders made of Belgian chocolate.

meanings.note: from a trip, by car, train or plane

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: + 3rd person verb: 'пусть строят' = let them build

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.en: strong, powerful (also used as a noun: the strong)

examples.text: Сильный ищет способ, а слабый ищет причину.
examples.trans: The strong man looks for a way, and the weak man looks for an excuse.
A strong wind was blowing outside.

examples.text: Надо заманить его на свою территорию. Там, где ты сильный.
examples.trans: You need to lure him onto your territory. Right where you are strong.

examples.text: Марина, я вам обещаю: со стеной ничего не случится.
examples.trans: Marina, I promise you: nothing will happen to the wall.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: The cup fell off the table.

examples.text: А потом на меня упал мусор с ветки.
examples.trans: And then rubbish fell on me from a branch.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
